limitations: HTTP date is request start; inferred end is date + time_used milliseconds, not an independent response timestamp.
Top-level date is retained as report date; it is not the initial submission timestamp.
Console entries lack timestamps; do not assign them report dates or fabricated event times.
Overlap of scanner activity supports concurrent jobs, not necessarily distinct agents.
Only the specified 16 reports are analyzed; first observed means within this source set.
Secrets, wallet addresses, transaction values, query strings and raw arbitrary console content are omitted.
